Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor (2024 EA) — Funday Games / Ghost Ship Publishing

Genre: 2D Survivor Roguelite | Perspective: Top-down 2D | Players: Solo | Steam Rating: 86% Positive

🎮 Core Concept

A survivor-like roguelite set in the Deep Rock Galactic universe. Choose a dwarf class, mine resources, fight waves of bugs, and build chaotic overpowered loadouts. Combines Vampire Survivors' auto-attack loop with DRG's mining and class identity.

👤 Classes (4 DRG Classes)

Class Role Primary Weapon Secondary Weapon Mining Tool
Driller AoE/Sustained Flamethrower / Cryo Cannon Subata / EPC Reinforced Power Drills
Scout Mobile DPS GK2 AR / M1000 Rifle Boomstick / Zhukov SMG Pickaxe
Engineer Turret/Defense Warthog Shotgun / Stubby SMG PGL / Breach Cutter Platform Gun
Gunner Raw Firepower Minigun / Autocannon Bulldog / BRT7 Zipline

🔫 Combat System

  • Auto-attack — Weapons fire automatically (VS-style)
  • Aiming — Weapons target nearest/strongest enemy
  • Overclocks — Run-specific weapon modifications (powerful modifiers)
  • Artifact System — Passive buffs collected during runs
  • Mining — Actively mine resources during combat for crafting/upgrades

⛏️ Mining as Gameplay (Key Innovation)

  • Resources spawn in the arena
  • Mine them DURING combat for minerals, nitra, gold
  • Minerals power upgrades and unlock crafting
  • Creates dual-focus gameplay: fight + mine simultaneously
  • True to DRG identity

📈 Progression

In-Run

  • XP gems → Level up → Choose weapons/upgrades/overclocks
  • Mine resources → Mid-run purchasing/crafting
  • Artifacts provide passive bonuses

Meta-Progression

System Currency Effect
Account upgrades Minerals Permanent stat boosts per class
Weapon unlocks Gold/minerals New weapons and overclocks
Class upgrades Gold Class-specific stat improvements
Cosmetics Mining rewards Visual customization

🏆 Score & Achievement

  • Run scoring — Based on wave reached, enemies killed, resources mined
  • Per-class completion — Each class has distinct achievement tracks
  • Milestone unlocks — Specific achievements unlock new content
  • Difficulty scaling — Hazard levels similar to base DRG

🌟 Key Innovations

  1. Mining During Combat — Active resource gathering as dual-loop gameplay
  2. Established IP Integration — Leverages beloved DRG brand and class identity
  3. Overclock System — Powerful weapon modifiers from base DRG
  4. Class-Based Survivors — Each class plays fundamentally differently (unlike most VS-likes)

📊 Key Stats

  • Classes: 4
  • Weapons per class: 4+
  • Overclocks per weapon: Multiple
  • Average run: 20–30 minutes
  • Status: Early Access
